cases.title: Verify initial hidden state of the text box
cases.description: Verify that the text box (data-testid='text-box') is initially hidden by default without the 'show' class upon loading.

cases.title: Verify toggling text box visibility via toggle button
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Toggle Text Box' button (data-testid='toggle-button') toggles the visibility of the text box by adding or removing the 'show' class.

cases.title: Verify rapid repeated clicks on toggle button
cases.description: Verify that rapid repeated clicks on the 'Toggle Text Box' button are handled reliably, ensuring the final visibility state reflects the last user action without inconsistency.

cases.title: Hide Text Box via Close Button
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Close' button (data-testid='close-button') inside the visible text box hides the text box by removing the 'show' class.

cases.title: Populate Voice Dropdown on Text Box Open
cases.description: Verify that the system populates the 'Choose Voice' dropdown (data-testid='voice-select') with available voices from the Web Speech API after the user opens the text box using the 'Toggle Text Box' button (data-testid='toggle-button'), invoking getVoices and setting option values and display texts.

cases.title: Update Dropdown on Voices Changed Event
cases.description: Verify that if available voices change, the system listens for the 'voiceschanged' event and updates the 'Choose Voice' dropdown accordingly.

cases.title: Assign Selected Voice to Message Voice
cases.description: Verify that when a user selects a voice from the dropdown, it is correctly assigned to message.voice for speech synthesis.

cases.title: Select Voice from Choose Voice Dropdown
cases.description: Verify that users can select a voice from the 'Choose Voice' dropdown (data-testid='voice-select') and that upon selection, the system sets the chosen voice for speech synthesis.

cases.title: Initial Population of Voices on Page Load
cases.description: Verify that the 'Choose Voice' dropdown is populated with available voices when the page is fully loaded.

cases.title: Multiple Voice Selections and Last Selected Active Voice
cases.description: Verify that the system handles multiple voice selections, ensuring that the last selected voice is set as the active voice for speech synthesis.

cases.title: Voice Options with Specific Language Codes
cases.description: Verify that the application supports voice options including specific language codes, such as 'CN' for Chinese or 'US' for English, and accurately sets the voice containing these codes as the active voice when selected.

cases.title: Read text aloud using selected voice and textarea input
cases.description: Verify that when the user toggles the text box via the toggle button, enters text into the textarea, selects a voice from the voice dropdown, and clicks the 'Read Text' button, the system reads the entered text aloud using the selected voice.

cases.title: Dynamic Generation of Predefined Phrase Boxes
cases.description: Verify that the system dynamically generates predefined phrase boxes in the main section based on a data array, ensuring each box contains an image and a paragraph representing a phrase.

cases.title: Normal Click on Phrase Box for Speech and Highlight
cases.description: Verify that clicking on a phrase box reads the associated text aloud using the Web Speech API and visually highlights the box by adding the active class for 800 milliseconds.

cases.title: Sequential Clicks Across Different Phrase Boxes
cases.description: Verify that clicking sequentially across different phrase boxes correctly triggers speech playback and visual feedback for each box interactively.

cases.title: Rapid Repeated Clicks on the Same Phrase Box
cases.description: Verify that rapid repeated clicks on the same phrase box accurately trigger speech playback and visual feedback without breaking system state.

opinions.feedback: The proposed test cases are comprehensive, well-structured, and appropriately cover the requirements without any confirmed blockers or redundancies.

analysis.analysis: Analysis completed for all requirements: e2edev_bench_04-R-1 through e2edev_bench_04-R-6. Redundant test cases G-004 and G-005 have been identified and removed to eliminate duplication of initial hidden state and toggle button behavior checks. All atomic behaviors, triggers, expected outcomes, and scenario types have been mapped accurately to individual requirements without inventing unsupported edge cases.
